instruction: Explain the control parameters of the IC converter at bus 3.
output: Interlinking Converter (IC) connected to bus 3 operates in bidirectional mode, with base frequency of 60.0Hz. Bus support capacitance is 0.0080 pu,  grid-side resistance is 0.0050 pu, grid-side inductance is 7.5000 pu.

instruction: Explain the control parameters of the IC converter at bus 28.
